sentences.text: Hence the petitioners present this petition for quashing of the proceedings in C.C. No:3128/2022 pending on the file of Prl. Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Koppal.

2) Further submitted that after the registration of the complaint the charge sheet has been filed and the same has been challenged before this Hon'ble court by the accused No. 1 to 7 and after obtaining of Interim order by the advise of the elders of the both the family the complainants family and accused family and also on the advise of the counsel respective parties the accused persons and the complaint and respondent No. 2 had NC: 2025:KHC-D:8576 HC-KAR come to the conclusion for amicable settlements to maintain the peace and harmony and to continue good cordial relationship between accused family and complainants family and also to settle the dispute once for all.
Hence the same may kindly be accept the compromise petition and quash the entire proceedings including complaint FIR and charge sheet in the interest of justice.

3) It is further submitted that wife of accused No. 1 i.e, Shailshree is residing in the house of accused No. 1 along with their family members and out of their martial relationship they got one child so to continue the good relationship and in the interest of my son in law and also my daughter the complainant i.,e respondent No. 2 having no objections to quash the proceedings in view of the settlement between the parties.

Hence the same may kindly be accept in the interest of justice 4) The complainant/respondent No. 2 she has withdrawn all the allegations made against the accused persons as alleged in the complaint and all the allegations are made because of some ill will advisors of some family members now the complainant realised that and accordingly to maintain a good relationship and also in the interest of both the family.
The allegation has been completely withdrawn and also the complainant/respondent No. 2 has no objections to quash the proceedings against all the accused persons in the interest of justice.
5) It is further submitted that the petitioners and respondents states that if the compromise petition is allowed there is no hardship nor injustice causes to other side.

The contents of the entire compromise petition was read over and explained me in my vernacular language NC:
2025:KHC-D:8576 HC-KAR and contents were understood and the present compromise petition and the above compromise petition is filed wilfully without any force nor any undue advantage nor it is not violates the rights of the parties.
And the above compromise petition explained in detail and we had gone through the same and they are correct to the best of our knowledge.

Wherefore the petitioners/accused No. 1 to 7 and the complainant/respondent No. 2 most respectfully prays this Hon'ble court may please to accept the compromise petition, consequently prays to quash the entire complaint, FIR, and charge sheet in Crime No. 38/2022 in C.C.
No:3128/2022 pending on the file of Prl. Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Koppal, for the offence punishable under section 498A, 323, 504, 109, 149 of IPC And section 4 of the dowry prohibition act, 1961., registered by the Koppal Women Police Station justice and equity."
